mapper.sql: select d.*, u.username as username from donation d left join `user` u on d.user_id = u.id
mapper.insert: insert into donation (user_id, type, amount, item_name, quantity, description, status, donate_time) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{itemName}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{status}, #{donateTime})
mapper.select: where d.user_id = #{userId} order by d.donate_time desc
mapper.update: update donation set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
